name: Houseplan
tagline: Fast residential massing and presentation with real-time rendering as positioned on the vendor site.
meta_desc: Targets users who need quick 3D schemes rather than full mechanical CAD. Feature depth and file exchange differ from GstarCAD—treat it as a separate lane when planning tutorials and deliverables.

terms.title: Residential Massing
terms.short_def: Technical best practices for Residential Massing inside Houseplan.
terms.definition: Residential Massing creates initial 3D volumes, floor partitions, and mass orientations.
terms.why_matters: Allows rapid conceptual design and early client feedback before detailed drafting starts.
common_pitfalls: Adding detail features like doors and windows before checking mass heights
Ignoring zoning set-back boundaries during early massing setups

quiz.question: When working with Residential Massing, which of the following represents a common technical pitfall?
options: Adding detail features like doors and windows before checking mass heights.
Failing to manually re-index the SQL server database.
Over-allocating virtual memory caches in the cloud settings.
Restricting linetype scales strictly to 1:1 paper coordinates.
quiz.explanation: Correct. A common pitfall is 'Adding detail features like doors and windows before checking mass heights.' As the editorial review notes: 'Allows rapid conceptual design and early client feedback before detailed drafting starts.'

terms.title: Real-Time Presentation
terms.short_def: Technical best practices for Real-Time Presentation inside Houseplan.
terms.definition: Real-Time Presentation renders materials and lighting setups on 3D elements instantly.
terms.why_matters: Enhances client presentations and supports quick material studies under varying sun angles.
common_pitfalls: Applying high-resolution textures that lag during walk-through animations
Overlooking color temperature settings causing unrealistic interior light

terms.title: Conceptual Rendering
terms.short_def: Technical best practices for Conceptual Rendering inside Houseplan.
terms.definition: Conceptual Rendering exports lightweight 3D pictures and viewpoints for client sharing.
terms.why_matters: Produces fast presentation graphics without needing heavy standalone visual render engines.
common_pitfalls: Rendering from incorrect camera perspective angles causing spatial distortion
Neglecting to define background environments before exporting final views

faqs.question: How do I export Houseplan files to GstarCAD?
faqs.answer: Use the Export command and select DWG format. Intelligent walls and massing elements will convert to standard 2D/3D entities.

faqs.question: Can I import custom material texture files?
faqs.answer: Yes, in the Material panel, add a new material and browse to import PNG/JPG files for diffuse and normal mappings.

faqs.question: How to create visual animations of the 3D model in Houseplan?
faqs.answer: Set up multiple camera viewpoints along a path, and click Export Video in the presentation panel to render a walk-through.
